description:
Registration Deadlines and Instructions. All participants must register to participate in this industry day. Interested parties must submit their registration via email, within the registration window for attendance.

  • Registration Window: April 24, 2026 through May 8, 2026
  • Registration Email: christopher.t.frost4.civ@mail.mil
  • Required Information:
    • Email Subject: [Company Name], "PPA IT Softwarre Solutions"
    • Email Body:
      • Company name, attendee names and titles
      • Contact information for each attendee
      • A brief capability statement highlighting relevant IT software solutions.
      • If you request to demonstrate your IT software solution capability to the PPA.

See provided document for additional information.
